decisions.rationale: CER-INVENTORY: C2c Explicit inputs and output boundary defines the pinned expected criterion and observation sets, visible gaps and subset labeling; CER-01/06 are future controls. No inventory collector or canonical schema changes are made.

CER-PROVENANCE: C2c records exact source/passport/plan/provider/run/step/artifact provenance and separates declared execution source from attestation. CER-03/04/10 describe future checks. The cited consumer prototype is local supporting evidence, not integrated production code.

CER-OUTCOME: C2c explicitly separates binding integrity, outcome and admission, retaining failed and unavailable observations. CER-02/05/08/10 specify future regression expectations. Existing coverage, runtime reports and statuses are unchanged.

CER-CONFLICT: C2c proposes idempotence of agreeing records and order-independent visibility of conflicts and ambiguous attempts. CER-07 is a proposed test, not a claimed executed integration test; no aggregation policy implementation changes.

CER-BOUNDARY: C2c Ownership and integration seam preserves FeaturePassport authority, explicit provider registration and the 0225 admission boundary. No production source, receipt issuer, canonical transition, metric activation or dynamic loading is introduced.
